trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload NullPointerException crash
trello.desc: Marcus owns fix for top Android crasher ~4% of Android sessions. Reproduce: start a photo upload on Android 14, background the app before upload finishes, then return to app. Crash occurs as NullPointerException in media picker callback. Fix the callback null handling / lifecycle management to prevent crash on backgrounding. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces on Android 14, fix landed and verified by Wednesday 2025-08-13 to allow QA time before mobile release on 2025-08-20. Sam to confirm fix on Android 14 test devices and add to regression run.

trello.name: Build backend sync API for offline notes
trello.desc: Elena builds sync endpoint for offline notes support promised to enterprise customers. Endpoint accepts client last-synced timestamp and returns delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for this sprint; no merge UI. Acceptance criteria: API returns correct delta, handles timestamp correctly, implements last-write-wins. Have PR in review before Elena is out on 2025-08-17 and 2025-08-18.

trello.name: Implement client offline cache and sync for notes list
trello.desc: Marcus implements client side offline mode for notes list. Use Room for local cache, queue writes while offline, replay queued writes when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: user can open app in airplane mode, view existing notes, create/edit notes offline, and all changes reconcile with server when online with no data loss. Write acceptance criteria into ticket as discussed.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam completes migration of pipelines to GitHub Actions. Proof of concept for build job already exists. This sprint finish test and release pipelines, preserve nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Keep Jenkins alive until parallel run is clean. Acceptance criteria: build, test, release, and nightly jobs run successfully on GitHub Actions in parallel with Jenkins for one week with no discrepancies.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena adds protection after incident where misbehaving script hammered search endpoint. Implement per-user rate limiting at 100 requests per minute per user. Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded. Add metrics counter to track users hitting the limit. Acceptance criteria: rate limit enforced per user, correct 429 response with Retry-After, metrics exposed and visible.

trello.name: Update privacy consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus updates consent screen for EU launch, launch blocker for 2025-08-20 release. Legal flagged current screen does not meet GDPR. Get new copy from legal and rebuild screen with opt-in consent and separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Nothing pre-checked. Acceptance criteria: consent is opt-in, separate toggles for analytics and marketing present, no pre-checked boxes, screen included in August 20 release.

trello.name: Add automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam creates automated regression coverage for payments flow which currently has none. Tests required: purchase, restore purchase, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Tests must run in CI as part of new GitHub Actions pipeline. Acceptance criteria: tests pass in CI, cover all four flows, and are included in the GitHub Actions test pipeline.
